description: Website Antibot. Single-pass scan that names the bot-protection vendor in front of a URL so you can choose the right BrowserSolver fetch tier next. Credit cost: 1 credit per call.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

query.description: Full URL or bare domain to scan for bot-protection vendors.

timeout.description: Upper bound for waiting on the target HTTP response, expressed in seconds (defaults to 15).
